question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Full query: Find the product in top 20% with smallest percentage-point change in share
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999
        AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE 1.0 * sales_q4_2020 / sales_q4_2019 >= 1.20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999
        AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        prod_name,
        SUM(total_sales) as total_sales_both_quarters
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
),
product_with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        prod_name,
        total_sales_both_quarters,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_both_quarters DESC) as quintile
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name
    FROM product_with_rank
    WHERE quintile = 1
),
quarterly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(total_sales) as grand_total
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.prod_name,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
        pqs.total_sales,
        qt.grand_total,
        100.0 * pqs.total_sales / qt.grand_total as share_pct
    FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN quarterly_totals qt ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
    WHERE pqs.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_pct)
),
share_change AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        prod_name,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN share_pct ELSE NULL END) as share_q4_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN share_pct ELSE NULL END) as share_q4_2020,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN share_pct ELSE NULL END) 
        - MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN share_pct ELSE NULL END) as pct_point_change
    FROM product_shares
    GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    prod_name,
    ROUND(share_q4_2019, 4) as share_q4_2019,
    ROUND(share_q4_2020, 4) as share_q4_2020,
    ROUND(pct_point_change, 4) as pct_point_change,
    ROUND(ABS(pct_point_change), 4) as abs_change
FROM share_change
ORDER BY ABS(pct_point_change) ASC

{"sql": "-- Step 3: Calculate product shares and total sales for ranking
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_q4_2019,

        AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE 1.0 * sales_q4_2020 / sales_q4_2019 >= 1.20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        p.prod_name,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE s.promo_id = 999
        AND co.country_name = 'United States of America'
        AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
        AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT

        prod_name,
        SUM(total_sales) as total_sales_both_quarters
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
),
product_with_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        prod_name,
        total_sales_both_quarters,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales_both_quarters DESC) as quintile
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_pct AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name

),

quarterly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(total_sales) as grand_total

),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.prod_name,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
        pqs.total_sales,
        qt.grand_total,
        100.0 * pqs.total_sales / qt.grand_total as share_pct
    FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN quarterly_totals qt ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
    WHERE pqs.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_pct)
)
